requirements.title: ATAN2D arguments satisfy the source restrictions
requirements.definition: Y shall be real; X shall have the same type and kind type parameter as Y; if Y is zero, X shall not be zero.

pending.atan2d-y-real: Positive plan: declare real Y with a nonzero sentinel value and call ATAN2D(Y, X); source-control mutations replace Y with a non-real expression but no diagnostic is claimed because the restriction is unnumbered.
pending.atan2d-x-same-type-kind-as-y: Positive plan: call ATAN2D with Y and X of the same selected real kind and compare KIND(ATAN2D(Y,X)) with KIND(X); source-control mutations use a different kind only as non-diagnostic controls.
pending.atan2d-not-both-zero-when-y-zero: Positive plan: exercise Y==0 with X initialized to a nonzero real value and separately a nonzero Y; do not ship a Y==0,X==0 negative unless a future numbered diagnostic obligation reaches it.

requirements.title: ATAN2D result value is a degree-valued atan2 result in the stated range
requirements.definition: The ATAN2D result is expressed in degrees, lies in the range -180 through 180, and approximates ATAN2(Y,X) multiplied by 180/pi.
